text: In 1973, on an uninhabited island off the Cornish coast, [a lone wildlife volunteer|who_suffers|the lonely and isolated] keeps daily watch over [a rare flower|images|plants, trees and fungus]. Over three days a lichen grows across the petals and [across her own body|rules|the body changes], and the line between what is real and what is nightmare begins to slip. Around her drift a sinister standing stone, a teenage girl who may be her younger self, a preacher, a fisherman she may once have loved and [ghostly miners in the island's tunnels|threat|the restless dead].
